instruction.text: How many millilitres make one litre? Choose the correct answer on the right side.

end.text: Good job. 1`l` has the same volume as 1000`ml`. This means that 1`l` has one thousand times as much volume as 1`ml`.
end.sound: Good job. 1 litre has the same volume as 1000 millilitres. This means that 1 litre has one thousand times as much volume as 1 millilitre.

hint.sound: 1 litre has the same volume as 1000 millilitres.

atoms.b: To convert a volume given in litres to millilitres, the measurement needs to be multiplied by ((100 ++1,000 1,100)).

hint.sound: To convert a volume given in litres to millilitres, the measurement needs to be multiplied by 1000.

instruction.text: The capacity of a jug is 2 l. How much does the jug hold in millilitres? Choose the correct answer.
